notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.39.0.

New helpers
- Cash short alert: when a shift closes with a cash difference of Rs 200 or more (limit in Settings > Cloud > Owner page alerts), you get a "CASH SHORT / OVER" Telegram message straight away.
- Fill Food Costs (menu: Fill Food Costs): all items with no food cost in one list, type the costs and Save all, so profit reports are correct.
- Quick row on the order screen: your 8 best sellers of the last 30 days, one tap to add.
